question: If Morgan resigns nine months after her start date, does she keep the signing bonus?
ground_truth_answer: No. The $5,000 signing bonus is subject to repayment in full if Employee resigns within twelve (12) months of the start date, and nine months falls within that clawback window.

expected_citations.span_hint: Employee will receive a one-time signing bonus of $5,000, payable in the first paycheck, subject to repayment in full if Employee resigns within twelve (12) months of the start date.
